name: D-Lab
access_note: If you're interested in applying data science to the social sciences and humanities, D-Lab is the place to be! D-Lab offers workshops for UC Berkeley students, faculty, and staff, ranging from Python and R fundamentals to more advanced topics such as machine learning. It also provides research consultations. Check the official Workshops page for available sessions and registration details!

Inclusive Excellence Hub
access_note: Are you a graduate student looking for your community? The Inclusive Excellence Hub offers an inclusive environment where UC Berkeley graduate students can study, build meaningful connections, and feel like they belong on campus. The Hub also hosts a variety of events and activities where students can meet others and get involved in campus life. The Hub offers meeting rooms and drop-in study spaces and is open Monday through Friday from 9:00 AM to 4:30 PM.
